newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Jan 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Jan 28.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Education ministry study finds variable standards among universities.
-- Members of the parliamentary majority call for restricted use of the Robien law allowing firms to benefit from lower employers' payroll contributions if they use a shorter work week to save jobs.
-- Compagnie de Suez to keep concentrating on core activities, disengage from real estate, may consider alliance with Cie Generale des Eaux.
